'''Bartu''' was a warrior from [[Shienar]]. 

== Appearance ==
He shaved his topknot and was bald while following the [[Prophet]]. He was 5'9".{{ref/book|c|Bartu|comp}}

== Activities ==
He was one of the twenty Shienarans picked to accompany [[Ingtar Shinowa]] and [[Rand al'Thor]] on the hunt for the [[Horn of Valere]].{{ref/book|5|38}}

He then joined [[Masema Dagar]] when Masema became the Prophet. Along with [[Nengar]], he was one of only two Shienarans who chose to stay with Masema in [[Samara]]. They truly believed in Masema.{{ref/book|5|38}}{{ref/book|5|40}}

He was part of the [[Dragonsworn]] army that pursued the [[Shaido]] with [[Perrin Aybara]]. He was with Masema when he met with Perrin and reported a large quantity of grain found in [[So Habor]].{{ref/book|10|7}}

Bartu was killed by [[Cha Faile]] prior to the [[Last Battle]],{{ref||comp}} probably when Masema was ambushed after the [[Battle of Malden]].{{ref/book|12|p}}{{ref|{{c|Nengar}}}}
{{notes}}
